title: Run
description: A driven run and the counts it keeps of its map's llm steps.

map.description: The step map driving the run (`DriverCursor::map`).

llm_steps_declared.description: How many `llm` steps the map declares, over every state (map.rs `StepMap::llm_steps_declared`).

llm_steps_run.description: How many `llm` step attempts the run has begun, over its whole life, resumes included: one per `aep.drive.RunLlmStep`. A step retried once is two, as `steps run` counts it, and an unresolved attempt retried with `--retry-in-flight` is a second attempt although it keeps its attempt number. A cursor written before the count existed starts from the sum of its `attempts` at every `llm` step of the map.
